sloka: तथा तैः कृत्तगात्रैस्तु दशग्रीवेण मार्गणैः।बभूव वसुधा तत्र प्रकीर्णा हरिभिस्तदा ।। ६.९७.१ ।।
transliteration: tathā taiḥ kṛttagātraistu daśagrīveṇa mārgaṇaiḥ।babhūva vasudhā tatra prakīrṇā haribhistadā ।। 6.97.1 ।।

translations.english: That time the battlefield was strewn with bodies of Vanaras whose limbs had been severed by the arrows of Ravana.
